fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/release/... against an httptest server on localhost: picks each of the four platforms, reports both channels newest versions, and rejects a bad sha256, a platform missing from the manifest and a malformed manifest; nothing reaches github.com
fields.statement: internal/release resolves a channel (release or latest) to its manifest, reports its newest version, picks the running os/arch archive, downloads it and rejects it unless its sha256 matches the manifest

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/version-channel, with the channel base URL pointed at a fixture (a test override, no network), covers newer, same and older, an unknown channel and an unreachable channel; describe-golden is regenerated
fields.statement: rhiza version --channel release|latest prints the newest version on that channel and whether it is newer than the running build, and writes nothing
